verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents plain MergeTree DDL and the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so data stays readable by any stock ClickHouse client or engine, which keeps lock-in low. Its migration docs only describe moving data in, not exporting it out. Missing for 10: a documented export or offboarding path, a list of supported open export formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV to your own object storage), a bulk full-account export, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of leaving.
